# Irha Apparels

> B2B custom apparel manufacturer based in Sialkot, Pakistan for brands, wholesalers, importers, retailers and private-label buyers.

Irha Apparels presents custom apparel program categories and inquiry tools. Product feasibility, materials, construction, MOQ, sampling, pricing, production timing, shipping and documentation are confirmed after requirement review.

The website does not publish fixed commercial commitments or unverified certification claims. Buyers may also request a live factory view by video call during requirement discussion.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): B2B manufacturing overview and main buyer actions.
- [Collections](/products): Five canonical apparel categories with published products.
- [Catalogue](/catalogue): Buyer-friendly catalogue groups backed by published product data.
- [About](/about): Company and manufacturing context.
- [Manufacturing](/manufacturing): Requirement-led production workflow.
- [Compliance](/compliance): Buyer requirements and evidence-before-claims policy.
- [Inquiry](/inquiry): Unified B2B inquiry for quotes, samples, catalogue requests, references and meetings.
- [Studio](/studio): Non-binding concept preview for requirement discussion.
- [Contact](/contact): Email and WhatsApp contact options.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): Website privacy information.
- [Terms](/terms-of-service): Website terms; order-specific commercial terms are separate.
